title: Herb Crusted Sea Bass with Indian Curry Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring pan-seared sea bass topped with a fragrant herb crust and served with a rich Indian-inspired curry sauce.
instructions: Season the sea bass fillets with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, herb mix, and lemon zest.
Dip each sea bass fillet into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add infused oil and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the coated sea bass fillets to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
While the sea bass is baking, heat the curry sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the curry sauce and simmer for 2-3 minutes or until softened.
Serve the herb-crusted sea bass with the Indian curry sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
